newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ 72-day seasonal bills yield 8.988 pct at tender. [CORRECTED 00:50 GMT]
newsitem.headline: NZ 72-day seasonal bills yield 8.988 pct at tender. [CORRECTED 00:50 GMT]

text.p: The weighted average successful yield on NZ$75 million (corrects from NZ$150 million) of 72-day seasonal treasury bills at Tuesday's tender was 8.988 percent, the Reserve Bank said.

The weighted average successful yield for NZ$75 million of 91-day treasury bills was 8.824 percent versus 8.693 percent for the NZ$75 million of a similar maturity at last week's tender, the Reserve Bank said.
